proof_body:
by
  intro k hk n _
  have h := bernoulliFourierCoeff_eq hk n
  rw [bernoulliFourierCoeff, fourierCoeffOn_eq_integral] at h
  rw [← h]
  simp only [sub_zero, one_div, inv_one, one_smul, smul_eq_mul]
  congr 1
  funext x
  rw [fourier_coe_apply]
  congr 2
  push_cast
  ring
target_source: ∀ k : ℕ, k ≠ 0 → ∀ n : ℤ, n ≠ 0 → ∫ x in (0:ℝ)..1, Complex.exp (((-2 * Real.pi * n * x : ℝ) : ℂ) * Complex.I) * (bernoulliFun k x : ℂ) = -(k.factorial : ℂ) / (2 * Real.pi * Complex.I * n) ^ k
